paper_metadata.title: A 5-Gb/s OEIC With Voltage-Up-Converter
paper_metadata.abstract: In this paper (based on our previous paper at ESSCOMPARISON OF VARIOUS PUBLISHED OEICS CIRC 2004, “A 2.4 GHz-Bandwidth OEIC with Voltage-Up-Con- (* INDICATES MODIFIED TECHNOLOGY, ** CHARACTERIZES verter,” but new results for 4 Gb/s and 5 Gb/s have been added), SPECIAL TECHNOLOGY) an optoelectronic integrated circuit (OEIC) with an integrated voltage-up-converter (VUC) to enhance the frequency response of an integrated pin photodiode is presented. With the VUC a voltage of 11 V is generated on the chip without any additional external components. Thus, for a single-supply environment of 5 V the bandwidth of the OEIC is increased from 1.5 to 2.4 GHz. 9, For data rates of 1, 3, 4, and 5 Gb/s at a bit error rate of 10 sensitivities of 29.3, 24.3, 22.9, and 20.5 dBm, respectively, were measured at a wavelength of 660 nm. For the implementation of the OEIC a modified 0.6m silicon BiCMOS technology with = 25 GHz is used.

sections.title: MEASUREMENT RESULTS
sections.text_preview: For the experimental set-up, the OEIC was bonded on a PCB to obtain optimum high-frequency behavior.
